meta.rewardBasis: paper leaderboard points. Reward = 1000 x relative log-loss improvement over the pre-registered naive baseline x evidence factor x luck guard. No money, no wagering and no sportsbook price is involved.

gates.G1: Provenance - every input carries an official source URL (checked by scripts/lines/verify_lines.py)
gates.G2: Evidence - minimum number of bets placed after the price filter
gates.G3: Baseline - beats the pre-registered naive model out of sample (log loss lower than the baseline)
gates.G4: Significance - bootstrap 95% CI on ROI lies entirely above zero AND a paired sign-flip randomisation test shows the strategy beats its baseline (Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p < 0.05 across the whole family)
gates.G5: Holdout - positive ROI on the untouched 2026 regular season
gates.G6: Robustness - positive ROI in at least two seasons and no single bet carries more than 40% of gross profit
gates.G7: Non-redundancy - |correlation| below 0.50 with every higher-ranked qualified strategy
